# AfriWidget

> AfriWidget is a privacy-first collection of 99 free web utilities, including calculators for health, finance, business, education, publisher monetization, startup burn rate, creator sponsorship, remote work, and media streaming.

AfriWidget provides browser-based tools with no sign-up required for everyday calculations and academic planning. The following pages are the primary African education and admissions calculators:

## Reverse AdSense Calculator

[Reverse AdSense Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/reverse-adsense-calculator) — Calculate required monthly pageviews, daily traffic, and ad clicks needed to achieve target monthly Google AdSense revenue goals.

## Website Acquisition Valuation Calculator

[Website Acquisition Valuation Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/website-valuation-calculator) — Estimate market sale value and SDE valuation multiples for content blogs, SaaS software, affiliate sites, and digital businesses.

## Startup Burn Rate Calculator

[Startup Burn Rate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/startup-burn-rate-calculator) — Calculate gross burn, net burn rate, remaining financial runway in months, and zero cash date forecast for startups.

## Creator Sponsorship Rate Calculator

[Creator Sponsorship Rate Calculator](https://afriwidget.com/creator-sponsorship-calculator) — Calculate commercial rate cards for YouTube integrations, TikTok clips, and Instagram sponsorship posts.

## Remote Salary Converter

[Remote Salary Converter](https://afriwidget.com/remote-salary-converter) — Compare international remote salaries across countries using foreign exchange rates and purchasing power cost-of-living adjustments.

## Reddit Video Downloader Browser

[Reddit Video Downloader Browser](https://afriwidget.com/reddit-video-downloader) — Extract, preview, and download public Reddit videos with audio tracks in 1080p, 720p, and MP4 formats.

## User Success Stories & Impact Studies

[User Success Stories & Impact Studies](https://afriwidget.com/success-stories) — Real-world case studies of students, entrepreneurs, freelancers, and healthcare workers across Africa utilizing AfriWidget's free privacy-first web tools for academic placement, debt payoff, freelance rate optimization, and clinical safety.
